About Blue Flame Glass

At Blue Flame Glass, we believe glass should do more than just reflect. It should represent.

Based in New Braunfels and serving San Antonio and the Hill Country, we are a custom glass contractor that has built its reputation on high-performance glass, unmatched craftsmanship and local integrity. A sleek custom glass shower, a full commercial storefront or a custom window, it gets the same care.

We are proud to source locally, build reliably and serve our community with honesty and grit.

Meet the owner

Meet Brent. A Texan who builds glass for Texans.

Brent Murphy is the owner of Blue Flame Glass and a professional glass fabricator and installer. He is not a middleman. He buys his glass from Texans, fabricates it in Texas and installs it in Texas, because he lives in Texas.

That means the person standing behind your project lives here too. Every custom glass shower, custom window, mirror and storefront is measured, cut and finished with that in mind, because Brent puts his name on it in the state where he and his family live.

Questions

Custom glass questions, straight answers.

Are estimates free?

Yes. Estimates are free. Call (830) 830-BLUE or send the form and we will get you a price.

Do you install custom glass showers in San Antonio and New Braunfels?

Yes. We design and install custom glass showers for homes in San Antonio, New Braunfels, Cibolo, Canyon Lake, Spring Branch and Bulverde. Frameless, semi-frameless, sliding and fully enclosed styles, custom sized to your bathroom with premium hardware and leak-resistant installation.

Do you offer custom windows in New Braunfels and San Antonio?

Yes. We provide custom windows and window replacement for homes and businesses in New Braunfels, San Antonio and the surrounding Hill Country, with custom sizes and styles, energy-efficient options and seamless installation.

Do you work on residential and commercial projects?

Yes. Blue Flame Glass is a custom glass contractor for both. For homes: shower enclosures, windows, mirrors, doors and decorative glass. For businesses: storefronts, curtain walls, office partitions, conference rooms, safety and tempered glass, and custom architectural designs.

Where does your glass come from?

Brent Murphy, our owner and a professional glass fabricator and installer, buys glass from Texas vendors, fabricates it in Texas and installs it in Texas, because he lives in Texas.

What areas do you serve?

San Antonio, New Braunfels, Cibolo, Canyon Lake, Spring Branch and Bulverde, plus Boerne, Blanco, Johnson City, Timberwood Park, Schertz, Converse, Seguin and more across the Hill Country. Not sure if you are in range? Call and ask.

What does custom glass manufacturing and installation include?

We measure your space, order and cut your glass to fit, then install it and clean up. That covers custom glass showers, custom windows, mirrors, cabinet glass and commercial glass.

Can I finance my glass project?

Yes. You can finance any job, no matter the size, through Acorn Finance. Checking your offers takes a few minutes online.

Are you bonded and insured?

Yes. Blue Flame Glass is bonded and insured through Miller and Miller Insurance Agency of New Braunfels.
